Infrastructure / Operations / Automation

Denis Tolochko

IT Systems Operations Engineer

I build reliable infrastructure, cloud operations, and automation systems for teams that need technology to stay calm under pressure.

My work sits where operations, security, and delivery meet: improving existing environments, removing repetitive work, and leaving teams with systems they can understand, maintain, and trust.

I’m open to new opportunities, practical collaborations, and candid feedback. I do my best to stay attentive to these channels, so if you see a useful connection or have an idea worth exploring, please get in touch.
